story.title: Psychotherapy
story.blurb: Living quietly with Squina and Squorchy, Emmett gets visitors from the Llamanian Republic: his old friend Los, and a job offer that involves keeping Seth sane.

lines.text: Laziness. Blissful laziness. For the first time in what felt like forever, Emmett felt whole. No worries for survival, no yearning for adventure, no stressing over his species. He lived now in a cozy little abode with two others on a flourishing, albeit cold, planet. It was winter—his favorite season—so he had an excuse to spend more time cuddling with Squina and Squorchy.

"Want to watch something later?" He was sitting on a sofa, browsing on his GU-sponsored incognito device. It was limiting, but it allowed him to use the holonet without divulging his existence. Squorchy was chopping up some berries, getting ready to prepare a stew of sorts.
